result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, makes all specified Excluded Claims uncapped, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and keeps qualifying Customer fee obligations outside the damages cap. The revision is confined to Section 21.1, resolves the prior contradiction created by “without exception,” and otherwise preserves the original allocation of risk. It is clear and professionally drafted.
